text: BANGKOK - Vietjet has won two awards at the 2026 World Business Outlook Awards, receiving the 'Best Investor Relations Airline - Global 2026' and 'Best Corporate Finance Strategy - Global 2026' titles .
The awards recognise the airline's efforts to enhance investor disclosure and develop financing strategies to support its long-term growth.

Under its hybrid airline business model, Vietjet works with international financial partners and employs various financing structures to expand its fleet, grow its flight network and invest in related aviation businesses.

The airline's Investor Relations team publishes business updates, strategic priorities, financial statements, annual reports and environmental, social and governance (ESG) reports in both Vietnamese and English on its investor relations website.

Hồ Ngọc Yến Phương, Vietjet's vice chairwoman and group chief financial officer, said investment decisions involving fleet expansion and network development reflected the airline's long-term commitments.
"We align how we raise and allocate capital with the group's growth plans and maintain an ongoing dialogue with investors about our priorities and how we intend to deliver on them," she said.

By strengthening relationships with international financial partners, Vietjet aimed to enhance its competitiveness and improve services for passengers on international routes under its hybrid airline model, she added.

Vietjet reported consolidated revenue of over VNĐ74.38 trillion (approximately US$2.9 billion) in the first nine months of 2026, up 41 per cent from a year earlier and equivalent to 86 per cent of its full-year target.
Consolidated profit after tax surpassed VNĐ1.72 trillion, representing 82 per cent of its annual target.
The airline carried more than 20.7 million passengers on 111,700 flights during the period and operated 223 routes, including 176 international and 47 domestic services.
The World Business Outlook Awards are presented annually by World Business Outlook magazine to recognise achievements and innovation in business and finance worldwide. - VNS
